title: Saving Email format over HTTP keeps Estimated clicks, so the switch actually turns on
steps: Run the send ledger suite against a private PostgreSQL (TEST_DATABASE_URL) from this branch.
expect: POST /api/ops/invitations/real/mail-format with all six fields, clickTracking true, answers 200 and the next read returns clickTracking true.
A body with a field the format does not have answers 400.
evidence: On dev on 16/10/2026, saving Email format with Estimated clicks on answered 400 REAL_INVALID_INPUT: the door still listed the five older fields, so the switch stayed off and test sends carried no tracked links.
fence: Private test database only; no mailbox, no customer address.

tests: over HTTP: Email format saves every field it has, including clickTracking, and refuses others
